renderings.kjv: and over his host was Nahshon

elsewhere.note: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,
Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
